newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-ATHERTON AND LLANES JOIN ENGLISH CLUBS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-ATHERTON AND LLANES JOIN ENGLISH CLUBS.

text.p: The list of overseas players in English rugby increased further on Friday when Richmond and Bath signed international lock forwards from South Africa and Argentina respectively.
Steve Atherton, who won eight Springbok test caps, signed a 30-month contract with Richmond, while Bath have been strengthened by Pumas' second-row German Llanes, capped 33 times by Argentina.
The giant Llanes, 28, joins his fellow-countryman Federico Mendez in the Bath pack and is expected to make his debut later this month. He has been playing in Italy with Milan.

England coach Jack Rowell expressed concern earlier this week about the number of non-English qualified players playing for domestic clubs. Champions Bath, for example, now have an American, an Argentine, two Welshmen and a Scot competing for places in the back five of their pack.
